title: Kaki Meja yang Goyang
subject: a husband who quietly fixes the wobbly leg of the old wooden writing desk his wife refuses to throw away, and pencils both their names under it
caption: Indonesian piano cabaret pop ballad in the Sal Priadi vein. Upright piano with rolling left-hand chords, brushed snare and soft kick, walking double bass, muted trumpet answering the vocal lines. Small-room dry recording, close-miked, a little tape warmth. Warm male baritone, tender and close, half spoken at line ends. 78 BPM, E-flat major. Mood of quiet married affection at night. No synth pads, no trap drums, no autotune, no orchestral swell, no rock guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - upright piano, brushed drums]
[Verse 1]
Meja kayu dari kosmu dulu
Kakinya goyang sejak pindah
Kamu ganjal pakai kertas tagihan
Kamu bilang, jangan dibuang
[Pre-Chorus]
Malam ini kamu sudah tidur
Aku pinjam obeng tetangga sebelah
[Chorus]
Pelan-pelan kubetulkan kakinya
Biar suratmu nggak miring lagi
Di bawah meja kutulis nama kita
Pakai pensil, biar kamu nggak tahu
[Verse 2]
Pagi-pagi kamu menulis
Kopi nggak tumpah ke catatan
Kamu ketuk meja dua kali
Lalu lihat aku, curiga
[Chorus]
Pelan-pelan kubetulkan kakinya
Biar tanganmu tenang menulis
Di bawah meja ada nama kita
Kalau kamu nunduk, kamu tahu
[Outro - muted trumpet, piano]
Kamu nunduk, kamu ketawa
Kamu tambah gambar hati kecil
